name: Every Fixed Auxiliary Level Has pc-Minor Closure MaxMin
statement: For every fixed integer $k\geq0$, $\operatorname{Cl}_{pc}(\mathsf M_k)=\mathsf{MaxMin}$ under the displayed-coordinate convention.
proof: Each level is projection-closed, and conditioning moves only to a higher auxiliary level, so every pc-minor belongs to MaxMin. Since $\mathsf{Max}=\mathsf M_0\subseteq\mathsf M_k$, the pc-minor closure contains the pc-minor closure MaxMin of maximum classes.
